breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to 'Calculate the internal axial force in each segment AB, BC, and CD using equilibrium analysis,' treating the axial force as piecewise constant per segment rather than uniform along the full bar. The flawed instruction to treat internal force as uniform along the full length has been removed.
